title: Recommendations on Best Bank to Switch to - HSBC Is Exiting AU
body:
Hello Ozbargainers,
You may've heard that HSBC (our current bank) is exiting Australia, with their mortgages transitioning to Pepper Money, but they're closing all chequing/savings accounts and credit-cards.
For this reason, im in search of a new bank/financial institution(s) to move to, for morgtages plus retail banking.
Was hoping to ask the wise community for recommendations.
I know i can look on Canstar, but wanted to get some real-world experience feedback also.
The initial thing i'd like to understand is, is it still best to keep all your business with the same institution, or have Fast Payments made picking a best-of-breed services from different institutions much less of a headache? Are there any gotchas with splitting your business between many institutions?
The criteria we're primarily looking for is
Very low mortgage rate (our mortgage is quite large, so this is the priority)
Offset account
Good credit card, pref with points such as qantas (we pay off credit card completely every month, so high interest isnt an issue)
PaylD/Fast Payments in and out
Good app/internet banking
Not awful onboarding process and ongoing customer support
Would love to hear your thoughts, thanks!
